G_root_cause: The hub edge is only the corroborator. The actual defect is that sequence/drip have no null model for join rate: at >=1 join/block with a dominant amount, consecutive-index runs are guaranteed. A fix that keeps the CEX hub rule but gates sequence/drip on the local join rate (or excludes the 0.05 protocol minimum from sequence/drip as it already is from amount rules) would free the same 91 h34-35 wallets WITHOUT freeing c54 and c184's operator.
